title: onEnqueueDrain closures in sync_providers.dart read ref after an await with no ref.mounted guard
why: Both onEnqueueDrain closures (in syncWriteFacadeProvider and outboxSyncWriteFacadeProvider) do a ref.read after an await with no ref.mounted check, violating SM-4. Riverpod 3 throws UnmountedRefException if ref is used after its provider has rebuilt. Both providers watch activeProfileIdProvider/authStateProvider, which change on every profile switch or sign-out -- realistic during the network round-trip a drain takes. If that happens between the two awaits, the second ref.read(syncOrchestratorProvider)?.recordDrainAttempt() throws on a stale ref. The surrounding comment (sync_providers.dart:100-104) spells out the user-visible cost of skipping recordDrainAttempt: 'the badge stays at its old value (e.g. a stale Synced) ... a false-Synced when the push failed.' Because this closure runs inside unawaited(tee().catchError((Object _) {})) in outbox_sync_write_facade.dart, the resulting exception is silently swallowed (see the companion EH-3 finding), so this failure currently has zero observability.
recommendation: Check ref.mounted after the first await in both closures before the second ref.read call, per SM-4; extract the duplicated closure body into one shared helper to fix both sites at once.
acceptance_criteria: custom_lint/riverpod_lint rule flagging ref use after an await without a mounted check (SM-4 Enforce backstop).
Provider test that rebuilds/switches the active profile mid-drain and asserts no UnmountedRefException reaches the caller and recordDrainAttempt either completes or is safely skipped.
